Crude Oil Futures Drop Amid Iran Talks and Saudi Pipeline Progress

Crude oil futures fell 3% to Rs 8,572, influenced by reports of potential talks between the U.S. and Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Oil prices were mixed as traders considered these developments alongside progress on a Saudi pipeline. Brent crude fell below $100 per barrel following reports of U.S. President Trump discussing talks with Iran.
